# RSVP Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](gmeow-RsvpStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RsvpStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)

The RSVP response status as asserted by an invitee — a VALUE vocabulary, distinct from [`InvitationStatus`](gmeow-InvitationStatus.md) so that organizer and invitee claims can coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](gmeow-RsvpStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
